title: Repair hazard/poison/disease/trap source procedures and selected stateful capabilities
description:
Repair known hazard/poison/disease/trap projection defects: success branches, variants,
Sphere of Annihilation, detection/trigger/disarm/geometry, recurrence/progression/cure/
immunity/termination, and harvesting-versus-target-effect distinctions. Preserve
source/procedure relationships for discovery; deterministic state transitions remain
required where state is actually mutated.
acceptance_criteria:
- Known hazard-family source-fidelity defects are repaired against source evidence.
- Source-defined variants remain separately addressable and option-local.
- Independently enumerable printed branches/fields cannot silently disappear.
- Positively selected hazard operations use correct provider-neutral execution and deterministic state mutation.
- The bead does not require every hazard to be an end-to-end deterministic state machine.
